items.t: Jerky shifts or slipping into neutral (dual-clutch transmission)
items.job: Transmission software update; mount or transmission replacement if needed
items.note: Most cases need only a software update or mount. Check for open campaigns; a replacement out of warranty is the high end.

items.t: Coolant line leak and coolant warning
items.job: Replace leaking coolant line and refill coolant

items.t: Won't unlock or start with 'Battery - Start Engine' message
items.job: Control unit software update; replace battery if tested bad
items.note: RepairPal estimates a GLB 250 battery at about $370-$510 installed.

items.t: Humming or vibration from the rear when maneuvering
items.job: Diagnose rear axle noise and apply bulletin repair
items.note: RepairPal lists noise diagnosis at about $200-$290.

items.t: Creaking or grinding from the steering column
items.job: Diagnose steering noise; grease input shaft or replace switch module

items.t: Front brakes squeal
items.job: Replace front brake pads with updated parts

items.t: MBUX screen or radio freezes
items.job: Head unit software update; replace head unit if hard drive fails
items.note: A software update is usually all that's needed and is often free under warranty.

items.t: Panoramic sunroof glass shatters
items.job: Replace panoramic roof glass
items.note: CarComplaints lists an average cost near $5,000. Comprehensive insurance may cover glass.

items.t: Mild-hybrid starter-generator software update
items.job: Starter-generator SCN coding update (service campaign)
items.note: Free service campaign.

items.t: Tire repair sealant bottle may leak
items.job: Replace TIREFIT sealant bottle (service campaign)
items.note: Free service campaign.

items.t: Right steering wheel buttons don't control the screen
items.job: Head unit software update and steering wheel recoding
items.note: Usually covered under warranty.

items.t: 'Park Assist inoperative' message
items.job: Diagnose parking sensors per bulletin

items.t: Check engine light from crankcase vent line switch
items.job: Diagnose and repair crankcase vent line switch circuit
